news.body:
## What moved
- The loan sanction letter is in hand, and it was the one thing on Tuesday's list you could not have fixed on the day.
You closed it yesterday morning along with the LMS tutorials, and you booked the Delhi slot on Friday. Campus France Delhi confirmed the dossier transfer the same day, so the EEF side is settled.
## What did not
- Both Google applications close today and neither has moved since their start-by on Tuesday.
The Amazon assessment is five days past its date too, while the Luxembourg application it belongs to is marked done.
- The KITAS expires today with no cancellation confirmed.
InCorp's revised quotation has been sitting since mid-October and the renewal window closed before you flew.
## Risks
- The visa now gates the money, and the money has no date.
INSEAD will not write SBI the refund undertaking and offered to extend your instalment deadline until the visa outcome instead. Marie Rose asked where you are in the visa process, and until you answer there is nothing on record and the board keeps reading 5 November.
- Tuesday has no slack in it, and the missing item is not yours to produce.
Delhi wants a printout of the automated Etudes en France completion mail and it has not arrived. If you are turned away there is no second slot booked, and the tuition date, the insurance and the euro account all sit behind it. Your counselling call also starts while you are still inside the centre.
- The x360 observer nominations are due 11 December, five days after your last day at Locus.
Naming your manager and peers is easy while you still have them.
## Put first this week
- Chase the Etudes en France completion mail tomorrow, not Tuesday morning. Muskan Jain answered within a day last time.
- Then write back to Marie Rose with where the visa stands, so the extension exists in writing rather than as an offer.
- Then one call to Chitra, to settle whether the KITAS is cancelled or simply left to lapse.
